full_judgment: 6. Ms. Nigar Sultana also submits that the case land is a silted up portion of a river and as per law, the same was recorded in the Khas Khatian No. 1 as a dried-up river which was fit for cultivation and regard being had to its nature, it was leased out to the petitioners as landless cultivators and in the absence of any complaint by any quarter about the misuse of the case land by the petitioners, the impugned order cancelling the lease of the petitioners is malafide and of no legal effect.
